summary: Read-only, claim-first, contract-level pre-implementation plan audit: low-risk plans skip via a fast-path; otherwise reality-check + design audit + optional pre-review + adversarial cross-LLM review feed a Class-tagged (spec_gap|premise_failure) PLAN_AUDIT_REPORT.md, then Phase 5 auto-amends spec_gap findings via /z-amend and surfaces premise_failure concerns as a prose brief, with a Phase 9 preference-elevation proposal.

entry_points.summary: Low-risk plans skip Phases 1-5, emit skip_recommended verdict, route to /z-execute.
Opt-in (runtime.pre_review) 3-way parallel Flash pre-reviewer scan feeding Phase 3 prompts.
consultant-primary/consultant-secondary Agent() dispatch over contract artifacts + Phase 1/2 notes.
Assigns spec_gap or premise_failure to every surviving finding, per z-review-all's enum.
Resolves workflow.audit_to_amend via config.py + amend-gate-decision.py before user interaction.
Auto-amends spec_gap via /z-amend (no flag; completed-task guard lets its Phase 4 gate auto-proceed), renders premise_failure as prose brief.
Prose alignment summary replaces the old AskUserQuestion popup.
Sets outcome/next/approach and renders via run-brief before plan_audit_end.
Proposes promoting workflow.audit_to_amend to config/memory after repeated audit-to-amend patterns.
Releases slug claim before deregistering active-plan record; per-resource gating.

invariants: Command is read-only for production code and plan artifacts.
Every surviving finding in PLAN_AUDIT_REPORT.md has **Class:** immediately after **Severity:**.
Audit-plan classes are spec_gap or premise_failure only (not the full z-review-all enum).
Class, not severity, is the discriminator.
auto_split skips spec_gap findings whose referenced task is already completed [x] in TASKS.md.
INTENT-mode auto_split batches all spec_gap corrections into one /z-amend call; legacy mode amends one finding at a time.
force_ask emits a prose alignment summary, never an AskUserQuestion popup.
Run Brief owns the single user-facing completion surface (outcome/next/approach/status).
The claim is claim-first: acquire before register, and fixed to the audited slug with no use-new-slug escape.
skip_recommended plans bypass Phases 1-5 and the Phase 9 elevation proposer, going straight to teardown.
gotchas: The Class enum's authoritative source is z-review-all (skills/z-review-all/SKILL.md:773), not a hardcoded line number in a stale comment.
amend-gate-decision.py / resolve-question failures fall safe to force_ask/prose, never silently skip the gate.
PLAN_AUDIT_REPORT.md must exist and be parseable before Phase 5 extraction, else audit_artifact_missing + exit 1.
premise_failure findings may have no single affected task/file; amendment-brief.py's affected field is omitted, not left empty.
On any post-claim halt, release must run before deregister; release only if CLAIM_RC==0, deregister only if REG_RC==0.
--command /z-audit-plan is required on every plan-claim.sh call — omitting it breaks --expected-holder identity comparisons.

/z-amend has no --skip-user-gate flag (removed corpus-wide). auto_split's /z-amend calls carry no flag at all; the completed-task guard in Phase 5 step 2a (skip spec_gap findings whose task is already [x]) is what guarantees /z-amend's own Phase 4 gate finds an empty Touched-but-completed-tasks list and auto-proceeds (amend_user_gate_autoproceed).
